description.value: Berezan Liquor Store (Willoughby location) is one of six BC outlets operated by the Berezan Hospitality Group, a 100% Canadian family-owned company with over 30 years in hospitality. The store is situated in a strip-mall unit in Langley's Willoughby neighbourhood and is part of a larger group that also runs Sasquatch Mountain Resort, gaming centres, and a hostel at Big White. The group markets its stores on friendly staff, broad product selection, and in-store contests.
